symptoms.title: Yellowing from older leaves
symptoms.description: Yellowing usually starts along the margins of older lower leaves, then progresses toward the midrib and younger leaves.

symptoms.title: Wilting and leaf collapse
symptoms.description: Leaf stalks may buckle, and collapsed older leaves can form a skirt around the pseudostem while a few young leaves remain upright.

symptoms.title: Internal vascular discoloration
symptoms.description: A cut pseudostem or corm may show yellow, reddish-brown, or dark-brown discoloration in the water-conducting tissue.

symptoms.title: Splitting and plant decline
symptoms.description: Some plants develop lengthwise splitting near the pseudostem base, followed by progressive wilt, decline, and death.

treatment.title: Do not move the plant or soil
treatment.description: Leave suspected plants and surrounding soil in place. Keep people, tools, footwear, water, and vehicles from carrying contaminated soil to another area.

treatment.title: Report and confirm
treatment.description: Contact the local agriculture or plant-protection office for laboratory confirmation and containment instructions; similar wilts can look alike.

treatment.title: No curative treatment
treatment.description: Fungicides do not cure Panama Disease. Destruction or isolation of confirmed plants must follow local biosecurity authority guidance.

treatment.title: Contain the affected area
treatment.description: Restrict access and clean soil from tools, footwear, and equipment before applying an approved disinfectant according to local protocol.

prevention.title: Use certified clean material
prevention.description: Plant certified disease-free tissue-culture plants or other planting material from a reliable source.

prevention.title: Keep contaminated soil out
prevention.description: Control entry to the growing area and clean soil from footwear, tools, equipment, and vehicles before they enter or leave.

prevention.title: Manage water movement
prevention.description: Prevent runoff, floodwater, or irrigation water from carrying soil from suspected or infested areas into clean fields.

prevention.title: Use suitable resistant cultivars
prevention.description: Where locally available and recommended, choose cultivars resistant to the Fusarium race present in the area.
